text:
Two defects, both in issue_refund:

  src/payments/refund.py:44  The amount_cents > order.total_cents check was removed, so a refund larger than the order total is now accepted. A caller passing an inflated amount withdraws more than was ever paid.

  src/payments/refund.py:47  The db.transaction() wrapper was dropped and LedgerUnavailable is swallowed with `pass`. The refund row is created but the merchant ledger is never debited, and the caller is told it succeeded. This is a silent money-losing split-brain, not a degraded path.
